description: Reusable index-methodology primitives for selection, weighting, buffer rules, and starting instrument lists.

allowed_ir_sources: methodology-licensed local rule and universe entities
notes: MethodologyRule is the generic carrier for named rules in an index methodology.
IndexSelectionRule covers rules that choose eligible instruments or constituents.
IndexWeightingRule covers rules that assign or adjust constituent weights.
IndexBufferRule is a selection rule used to reduce unnecessary turnover or switching when the source text defines such a rule.
StartingListOfFinancialInstruments is the reusable type for a starting list of instruments before methodology-specific eligibility, selection, buffer, and weighting rules are applied.
StartingListOfFinancialInstruments may be sourced from another index, a fixed list, a client-provided list, an exchange universe, or another explicit candidate source.
Concrete universes, concrete rules, and concrete vague terms remain local entities in the methodology IR.
